territorial_scope.description: Applies to personal data in public and private databanks whose processing takes place in the national territory.

evidence.quote: cuyo tratamiento se realiza en el territorio nacional

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Peru's general personal data protection law. It applies to personal data in public and private databanks processed in national territory. It sets processing principles, consent and data-subject rights, security and cross-border transfer rules, and administrative fines enforced by the national data protection authority.
summary.long: Establishes the rules for processing personal data held in public and private databanks in Peru, with the stated object of guaranteeing the constitutional right to personal data protection (Art. 1). It applies to data processed in national territory and excludes purely personal or family databanks and certain public-sector databanks used for defence, public security and criminal matters (Art. 3). It sets principles including legality, consent, purpose, proportionality, quality, security and an adequate-protection standard for cross-border flows (Arts. 4-11). Processing requires prior, informed, express and unequivocal consent, subject to listed exceptions (Arts. 5, 13, 14); sensitive data requires written consent. Cross-border transfers are allowed only to countries with adequate protection, subject to listed exceptions (Art. 15). Data subjects hold information, access, update, opposition and objective-treatment rights, the latter against decisions with significant legal effects based solely on automated evaluation of personality (Arts. 18-23), and a right to compensation (Art. 25). Controllers and processors must ensure security and confidentiality (Arts. 9, 16, 17, 28). Databanks must be registered in a National Registry (Art. 34). The Ministry of Justice's National Directorate of Justice is the national authority, with sanctioning power (Art. 32). Infractions are classed as minor, serious or very serious (Art. 38); fines range from 0.5 to 100 UIT and may not exceed 10% of the offender's gross revenue of the prior year (Art. 39).

enforcement.authority: Autoridad Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales
enforcement.triggered_by: Minor infractions (leves) under Art. 38(1)(a)-(c): processing without required consent; not attending or obstructing data-subject rights; obstructing the supervisory function
enforcement.max_penalty_text: multa mínima desde cero coma cinco UIT hasta cinco UIT
enforcement.penalty_formula: Fine range set by Art. 39(1); amount graduated under Art. 230(3) of Ley 27444; total fine may not exceed 10% of the presumed infringer's gross annual income in the prior fiscal year (Art. 39, second paragraph)

evidence.quote: Las infracciones leves son sancionadas con una multa mínima desde cero coma cinco de una unidad impositiva tributaria (UIT) hasta cinco unidades impositivas tributarias (UIT)

enforcement.authority: Autoridad Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales
enforcement.triggered_by: Serious infractions (graves) under Art. 38(2)(a)-(e): breach of principles or other duties; breach of confidentiality (Art. 17); systematic non-attention or obstruction of data-subject rights or supervision; not registering the databank
enforcement.max_penalty_text: multa desde más de cinco UIT hasta cincuenta UIT
enforcement.penalty_formula: Fine range set by Art. 39(2); amount graduated under Art. 230(3) of Ley 27444; total fine may not exceed 10% of the presumed infringer's gross annual income in the prior fiscal year (Art. 39, second paragraph)

evidence.quote: Las infracciones graves son sancionadas con multa desde más de cinco unidades impositivas tributarias (UIT) hasta cincuenta unidades impositivas tributarias (UIT)

enforcement.triggered_by: Very serious infractions (muy graves) under Art. 38(3)(a)-(e): principle breaches that prevent or attack fundamental rights; unlawful creation or maintenance of databanks; false or incomplete information to the authority; failure to cease unlawful processing after a request; failure to register after a request
